milestone.name: Total Wins Milestone
milestone.label: Wins
milestone.description: This record recognizes a team that reaches a significant benchmark in all-time league victories. This achievement highlights long-term success, consistency, and dominance over multiple seasons.

milestone.name: Total Losses Milestone
milestone.label: Losses
milestone.description: This record marks a significant threshold in total career losses within the league. It reflects the team's longevity and perseverance, highlighting their continued participation and resilience despite the challenges faced over multiple seasons.

milestone.name: Total All-Play Wins Milestone
milestone.label: All-Play Wins
milestone.description: This record marks a significant benchmark in total all-play wins, reflecting a team's consistent ability to outperform the competition across multiple seasons. It highlights sustained success, demonstrating strong week-to-week performances against the entire league.

milestone.name: Top Half Score Milestone
milestone.label: Top Half Scores
milestone.description: This milestone recognizes a team for accumulating a significant number of weeks in the top half of league scoring, reflecting ongoing competitive play.

milestone.name: Bottom Half Score Milestone
milestone.label: Bottom Half Scores
milestone.description: This milestone recognizes a team for accumulating a significant number of weeks in the bottom half of league scoring, reflecting a lack of ongoing competitive play.

milestone.name: Total All-Play Losses Milestone
milestone.label: All-Play Losses
milestone.description: This record marks a significant threshold in total all-play losses, reflecting a team's consistent ability to underperform the competition across multiple seasons. It highlights sustained poor performance, demonstrating weak week-to-week performances against the entire league.

milestone.name: High Scores Milestone
milestone.label: High Scores
milestone.description: This record marks a significant threshold in the total number of weeks a team has posted the highest score in the league. It reflects their explosive performances, dominance in matchups, and ability to outscore the competition on multiple occasions.

milestone.name: Bottom Scores Milestone
milestone.label: Bottom Scores
milestone.description: This milestone recognizes a team reaching a notable total of weeks with a bottom score, highlighting repeated bursts of low-scoring misery.

milestone.name: Worst Scores Milestone
milestone.label: Worst Scores
milestone.description: This record marks a significant threshold in the total number of weeks a team has posted the lowest score in the league. It reflects their disastrous performances, weakness in matchups, and in-ability to outscore the competition on multiple occasions.

milestone.name: Top Scores Milestone
milestone.label: Top Scores
milestone.description: This milestone celebrates a team reaching a notable total of weeks with a top score, highlighting repeated bursts of high-scoring excellence.
